```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r load}
library(tidyverse)
library(car)
df <- read_csv("../data/bc_full_factorial_dataset.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
factors <- c("pH", "Temp_C", "RPM", "Inoculum_pct", "Sugar_gL")
low  <- c(4.0, 25, 50, 5, 20)
high <- c(6.0, 35, 200, 15, 60)
names(low) <- names(high) <- factors
df_coded <- df
for (f in factors) df_coded[[paste0(f,"_coded")]] <- 2*(df[[f]]-low[f])/(high[f]-low[f])-1
```

## Exercise 1 — Without interactions
```{r ex1}
full_model <- lm(BC_yield_gL ~ pH_coded + Temp_C_coded + RPM_coded + Inoculum_pct_coded + Sugar_gL_coded +
  pH_coded:Temp_C_coded + Sugar_gL_coded:RPM_coded +
  I(pH_coded^2) + I(Temp_C_coded^2) + I(RPM_coded^2) + I(Inoculum_pct_coded^2) + I(Sugar_gL_coded^2),
  data = df_coded)
reduced <- lm(BC_yield_gL ~ pH_coded + Temp_C_coded + RPM_coded + Inoculum_pct_coded + Sugar_gL_coded +
  I(pH_coded^2) + I(Temp_C_coded^2) + I(RPM_coded^2) + I(Inoculum_pct_coded^2) + I(Sugar_gL_coded^2),
  data = df_coded)
cat(sprintf("Full R²: %.4f\n", summary(full_model)$r.squared))
cat(sprintf("Reduced R²: %.4f\n", summary(reduced)$r.squared))
cat(sprintf("Delta R²: %.4f\n", summary(full_model)$r.squared - summary(reduced)$r.squared))
anova(reduced, full_model)
```

## Exercise 2 — Back-transform
```{r ex2}
cat("The back-transformation requires substituting coded = 2*(real-low)/(high-low) - 1\n")
cat("into the coded model. The resulting equation is a multivariate quadratic in real units.\n")
cat("The linear, interaction, and quadratic terms all change coefficient values.\n")
```

## Exercise 3 — Residual diagnostics
```{r ex3, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(full_model)
```

## Exercise 4 — Predict condition 2000
```{r ex4}
cond2000_coded <- df_coded %>% filter(condition_id == 2000) %>% slice(1)
pred <- predict(full_model, newdata = cond2000_coded, se.fit = TRUE)
actual <- mean(df$BC_yield_gL[df$condition_id == 2000])
cat(sprintf("Predicted: %.3f (SE=%.3f)\n", pred$fit, pred$se.fit))
cat(sprintf("Actual mean: %.3f\n", actual))
cat(sprintf("Residual: %.3f\n", actual - pred$fit))
```
